title: Asian Jim - The Office
summary: Jim 不在，Pam 找了个亚裔演员冒充 Jim 坐在他的工位上，假装两人一直是同事。Dwight 坚持他不是 Jim，最后真 Jim 出现，Dwight 彻底懵了。

lines.en: Who am I? I'm Jim. We've been working together for 12 years.
lines.zh: 我是谁？我是 Jim 啊。我们一起共事 12 年了。

lines.en: You're not Jim. Jim's not Asian.
lines.zh: 你不是 Jim。Jim 不是亚洲人。

lines.en: You seriously never noticed? Hey. Hats off to you for not seeing race.
lines.zh: 你真的一直没注意到？嘿，佩服你，完全不看肤色。

lines.en: All right, then, Jim. Uh, why don't you tell me about that sale that you made yesterday?
lines.zh: 好啊，那 Jim，你说说你昨天谈成的那笔单子？

lines.en: Uh, Wellington Systems? Sold them 10 cases of 24-pound letter stock.
lines.zh: Wellington Systems 那单？卖了他们 10 箱 24 磅的信纸。

lines.en: Or were you talking about Krieger-Murphy? Because I didn't close that one yet, but I'm hoping I've got a voicemail from Paul Krieger waiting for me.
lines.zh: 还是说 Krieger-Murphy 那单？那单还没谈成，不过我希望 Paul Krieger 给我留了语音。

lines.en: Please enter your password. ... You have one new message.
lines.zh: 请输入密码。……您有一条新留言。

lines.en: How did you know? No! No, no. That is sensitive information. Only for employees, not outsiders!
lines.zh: 你怎么知道密码的？不行！不不不，这是机密信息，只给员工看，外人不行！

lines.en: Dwight, cut it out. I'm trying to work.
You don't work here! You're not Jim!
lines.zh: 你不在这儿上班！你不是 Jim！

lines.en: Jim, I got us that dinner reservation — Grico's, 7:30.
lines.zh: Jim，晚饭订好了，Grico's 餐厅，7 点半。

lines.en: Jim's at the dentist this morning, and Steve is an actor friend of ours.
lines.zh: （对镜头）Jim 今早去看牙医了，Steve 是我们的一个演员朋友。

lines.en: I don't know who you are, but you are not Jim. This is Jim!
lines.zh: 我不知道你是谁，但你不是 Jim。这才是 Jim！

options: 新同事第一天上班，Dwight 不欢迎他
有人冒充 Jim 坐在他的位子上，同事们配合整 Dwight
Jim 整容了，Dwight 认不出他
Dwight 认错人，把客户当成了 Jim
questions.explain: Pam 请了个演员冒充 Jim，大家一起演，专门整 Dwight。

questions.q: Dwight 质问后，假 Jim 说 "Hats off to you for not seeing race"，语气是？
options: 故意反讽：夸他“居然不看肤色”
questions.explain: Hats off to you = 佩服你；这里是反讽，装作 Dwight 从来没注意到 Jim 是亚洲人。

questions.q: 假 Jim 输入密码、听到留言提示时，Dwight 为什么急了？
options: 他发现对方真的知道 Jim 的语音信箱密码
questions.explain: Dwight 大喊 That is sensitive information——对方连密码都知道，让他更抓狂。

questions.q: Pam 过来说了句什么，让场面更像真的？
options: 说已经订好了晚饭，7 点半
questions.explain: I got us that dinner reservation — Grico's, 7:30：晚餐订好了。
